meta_description: West Alexandria Dental Care serves Seminary Hill, Fairlington, Shirlington, Parkfairfax, Del Ray, Landmark.
h1: A dental home for West Alexandria and the neighborhoods around it
intro: The office sits in the Bradlee Office Building on W. Braddock Road, steps from Bradlee Shopping Center and just off I-395 at the King Street exit, with free surface parking around the building. That puts it a few minutes from Seminary Hill, Fairlington, Shirlington and Parkfairfax, and an easy drive from Del Ray, Landmark, Lincolnia, Bailey's Crossroads and South Arlington.

sections.heading: Why the location works
body: Most of the people who come here are fitting dentistry around something else: a commute on I-395 or the Metro, school drop-off, shift work, a condo in Fairlington or Parkfairfax that is closer to this office than to anything in Old Town. Being just off the King Street exit with parking at the door means a 7 AM appointment before work or a 7 PM one after it is realistic rather than theoretical.

Seven-day hours are the other half of it. Saturday and Sunday mornings exist for the families and commuters who cannot make a weekday work. Read more about [evening and weekend appointments](/new-patients/evening-and-weekend-appointments/).

items.title: Seminary Hill
items.body: The neighborhood around the office itself, along W. Braddock Road, Seminary Road and Quaker Lane. Walkable for many residents.

items.title: Fairlington and Parkfairfax
items.body: Historic brick condo communities off Quaker Lane and I-395, a few minutes' drive and a natural fit for evening appointments after the commute.

items.title: Shirlington
items.body: South Arlington, about ten minutes via I-395 or Quaker Lane, with free parking at our door instead of a garage hunt.

items.title: Del Ray
items.body: North along Mount Vernon Avenue, a short drive via Braddock Road, with weekend mornings that suit young families.

items.title: Landmark, Lincolnia and Bailey's Crossroads
items.body: The West End and the Fairfax County side, reached via Duke Street, Seminary Road or Route 7, with four languages spoken and Virginia Medicaid accepted.

sections.heading: What people from these neighborhoods tend to need
items: One office for the whole household, from a toddler's first visit to implants for grandparents. See [family dentistry](/general-dentistry/family-dentistry/).
Insurance that actually works, including Virginia Medicaid alongside Aetna, Ameritas, Delta Dental, Humana, Cigna and MetLife. See [insurance we accept](/new-patients/insurance/).
Care in English, Arabic, Spanish or Portuguese. See [languages we speak](/new-patients/languages/).
Somewhere to go when a tooth breaks on a weekend. See [emergency dental care](/emergency-dentistry/).
A fresh start after moving to Alexandria or after years away from the dentist. See [switching dentists](/new-patients/switching-dentists/).

items.title: From I-395
items.body: Take the King Street exit, head toward Alexandria, and turn onto W. Braddock Road. The Bradlee Office Building is beside Bradlee Shopping Center.

items.title: From Quaker Lane or Seminary Road
items.body: Both cross W. Braddock Road within a few minutes of the office, which is the usual route from Fairlington, Parkfairfax and Seminary Hill.

items.title: Parking
items.body: Free surface parking around the building. No garage, no validation, no meter.

sections.heading: Not on the list?
sections.body: The neighborhood pages are starting points, not boundaries. Patients come from across Alexandria, Arlington and Fairfax County, and the welcome is the same wherever you live.

cta.heading: Close to home, open when you are free.
cta.body: Book online at any hour, or call and someone at the office will find a time that fits your week.
